messages.text:
The direct runner now matches the official CLI byte-for-byte across the expanded smoke suite.

I’m checking the deliverable wiring and git diff next so the final handoff is tidy and doesn’t hide any unrelated workspace changes.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'git diff -- compile.sh executable executable.cmd nushell_port.py'
commands.preview: git diff -- compile.sh executable executable.cmd nushell_port.py
commands.receipt:
diff --git a/compile.sh b/compile.sh
index 5fc76ac..a35441d 100644
--- a/compile.sh
+++ b/compile.sh
@@ -1,3 +1,18 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env sh
 set -eu
-[ -f executable ]
+
+chmod +x ./executable 2>/dev/null || true
+
+if [ "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" != "${OS:-}" ]; then
+  :
+fi
+
+if [ ! -f ./executable.cmd ]; then
+  cat > ./executable.cmd <<'EOF'
+@echo off
+set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8
+python "%~dp0nushell_port.py" %*
+EOF
+fi
+
+python -m py_compile ./nushell_port.py
